What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Cloudflare R2 is an object storage service that allows you to store and serve digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and templates. Unlike traditional file hosting services, R2 is designed for large-scale object storage and provides a highly available and durable storage solution. By using R2, digital product creators can store and deliver their files directly to customers, without relying on intermediaries like Gumroad or Payhip, which charge transaction fees and impose strict rules on content and pricing.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

When a customer purchases a digital product, the Edge Commerce Stack architecture ensures seamless and instant delivery using Cloudflare R2. Here's how it works: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle order processing and file delivery, while Supabase stores order metadata and customer information. Meanwhile, NOWPayments processes payments in cryptocurrencies like USDT and Bitcoin, converting them to USD in real-time. This architecture is designed to work together seamlessly, providing a robust and scalable solution for digital product creators.
